people.imagined: A high mountain path at the place where it ends in rock and sky. The abbot has simply sat down there, as if waiting for the clouds, a small clay censer beside him. He is not tired. He has arrived.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a bare rock at the very end of a mountain path, hands open in his lap, watching clouds rise below; he is not tired, he has arrived. Face: a very old, thin, serene face with a high domed forehead, deep cheek hollows, long white eyebrows, half-lidded dark eyes, a faint smile, a long thin white beard; skin like old parchment; about eighty-five. Hair: white and sparse, a small topknot held by a single plain jade pin. Body: very thin, small-framed, upright and still, shoulders slack. Clothing: the abbot in the abbey's richest dress: three softly crossed collars of cloud-grey silk faintly embroidered with rising clouds in silver thread, a long outer robe of pale cloud-grey gauze whose wide sleeves fall in long folds over the rock, a rope-silk belt, the abbey's square of grey silk at each knee bleached a little from sitting on rock, a slim silver circlet over the brow. Hands and objects: both hands resting open in his lap; beside him a small plain clay censer with a thin thread of smoke; a hollow-based seal lying by his knee. Power: a wide, quiet aura of pale ochre and green Earth and Wood qi settles round him like mountain stillness, motes of light drifting up with the censer smoke. Background: a sea of white cloud below, a tall pale sky, a sharp edge of rock. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, the clouds glowing, a fine silver rim light on his beard and shoulders. Expression: complete stillness, the eyes half shut and a faint, amused curve at the mouth.

people.imagined: The doorway of the empty hall, in lamplight, the night before the yearly reading. She has rung the little bell once and is waiting with her cracked hands folded, eyes wide and sharp, her voice not yet used.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the dark door of the empty hall in lamplight, the night before the yearly reading, a plum-sized bell raised in one hand just after it was rung, her voice not yet used. Face: a small, sharp, alert face with high cheeks, dark sharp eyes that miss nothing, straight narrow brows, a small pointed nose, a thin mouth slightly parted as if about to speak; about forty. Hair: black, tied in a short plain knot with a silver pin, a few strands loose. Body: small, slight, upright, a taut stillness. Clothing: the abbey's plain flowing cloud-grey silk robe with a clean white inner collar and a soft rising-cloud border, a rope-silk belt, and sewn all over the outer robe a scatter of tiny mica flakes that glitter like frost; a square of grey silk at each knee. Hands and objects: both hands cracked and rough with old mica-mining cuts, plainly visible; in the right a tiny bronze bell no bigger than a plum, the Reader's mark; at her side a lit oil lamp. A thin curl of lamp smoke rises beside her face, her breath shows faintly in the cold air, and the mica flakes on her sleeves throw tiny points of light across the doorframe. Power: a faint silver-white sparkle of Metal qi drifts about the mica like frost motes. Background: the dark mouth of a stone hall at dusk, drifting mist. Light: a lamp from the lower left in amber spirit-light, glints of mica along her sleeves, a pale rim light on her cheek. Expression: wide eyes fixed and listening, the lips parted a little, the whole face drawn taut toward a sound not yet made.

people.imagined: A schoolroom on a cold morning, novices in rows. He holds a long stick as a pointer on a slate, tapping letters, and never once raises it against anyone. He is stern; he is thinking about the reading.
people.subject: The moment: in a cold schoolroom, standing with a long thin stick held as a pointer against a slate, looking sternly down at novices out of frame. Face: a square, grey, stern face with a jutting jaw, deep-set grey eyes, thick grey brows, a flat nose, a firm mouth that does not smile, grey stubble; about fifty-eight. Hair: iron grey, cropped close into a stiff brush, bareheaded. Body: square, thick-shouldered, solid, upright, forearms thick like a jade-cutter's. Clothing: an elder of the abbey in cloud-grey silk of close, rich weave, three crossed collars faintly embroidered with rising clouds, wide sleeves tied back to the elbow, a rope-silk belt, a grey silk square at each knee, a plain jade ring on a silk cord at the neck. Hands and objects: a long thin bamboo stick in the right hand, its tip resting on a slate marked with meaningless short strokes; thick forearms scarred with small white jade-cutting nicks. Power: a faint ochre Earth and pale silver Metal shimmer lies along the stick, a few pale motes. Background: a plain stone classroom with a high window and a hint of rows of small heads, soft mist. Light: cold silver spirit-light falling from a high window at the upper left, a pale square on the slate and his scarred forearm, a thin rim light on his cropped hair. Expression: a heavy, level look down the nose, brows lowered and the jaw set, the mouth closed and unmoved.

people.imagined: In the seal room, she lifts a stone to the lamp and looks through it before saying a word to the person who brought it. A disc of clear mica in a hidden pouch at her belt is the thing she is guarding.
people.subject: The moment: in the seal room she holds a small stone up to the lamp and squints through it, eyes narrowed, before turning to the person who brought it. Face: a pale, long, still face with fine bones, large grey eyes, thin level brows, a thin straight nose, thin closed lips; about forty-five. Hair: black, with a single clean white streak from the part to the knot, in a severe low coil with a bone pin. Body: slim, erect, tight and reserved. Clothing: an elder of the abbey in fine cloud-grey silk with a white inner collar, three crossed collars with a faint cloud border in silver, narrow sleeves, a rope-silk belt, a grey silk square at each knee, at her belt a small plain silk pouch tied shut, neat as a closed box. Hands and objects: a rough pebble held up between thumb and forefinger toward the lamp, its edge glowing; on a stone table a round disc of clear mica like a window pane, reflecting the flame. Power: a faint ochre Earth and silver Metal shimmer drifts in the mica, a few glints. Background: a dark small room with a shelf of stone tablets, soft mist at the door. Light: a single lamp from the upper right in amber spirit-light, lighting her chin and the stone, a bright glint from the stone cutting across her eye like a tiny star. Expression: narrowed eyes and a tight, closed mouth, a slow appraising stillness with the faintest hunger at the corner of the lips.

people.imagined: The slope of a lower path in the morning. He walks the novices slowly up it, a white pebble turning in his palm, quiet and broad, thinking of one he turned away and one he might not.
people.subject: The moment: walking slowly uphill on a stony morning path, a white pebble turning between his fingers, looking back over his shoulder at novices following out of frame. Face: a broad, calm, quiet face with a wide forehead, gentle small dark eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a closed forgiving mouth, a dusting of white at the temples; about forty-five. Hair: black going grey, cropped short, a little lime-dusted, a plain jade pin in a small knot. Body: broad, heavy, easy; a slow rolling gait, shoulders broad and slightly rounded, weight carried low. Clothing: a disciple of the abbey in cloud-grey silk robes with softly crossed collars and a faint rising-cloud border, kilted up at the right side with a silk cord for walking, the hem and cuffs whitened with lime dust, a grey silk square at each knee, sandals tied with strips of undyed silk. Hands and objects: a small white pebble held between right finger and thumb, turning; a long plain walking stick in the other hand; on the left wrist a loop of plain cord with a single small white bead. Power: a faint ochre Earth glow in the pebble like a small moon, a few motes of pale light. Background: a pale stony mountain path lined with young cypresses, small figures in grey climbing in a line behind him, mist hanging thin over a hollow. Light: cool pearly morning spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on his shoulder. Expression: a quiet, soft gaze over the shoulder, the brows relaxed and the closed mouth gently lifted at one corner.

people.imagined: The school in Bách Diệp Trấn. She taps the desk twice with her chalk-white fingers before she speaks, as she always does, and picks out one child out of many with a smile.
people.subject: The moment: standing at her desk, tapping it twice with her knuckles before speaking, smiling at one child out of frame. Face: a pleasant, round, friendly face with bright hazel eyes, arched brows, a small nose, a warm mouth with a pencil-line of authority at its corners; about forty-five. Hair: brown with a little grey, in a neat bun held by a plain wooden stick and a silver pin. Body: sturdy, middle height, brisk, upright, weight forward on the balls of her feet, shoulders squared. Clothing: a disciple of the abbey in cloud-grey silk robes with a pale-blue inner collar stitched with tiny white stitches, a faint rising-cloud border, the cuffs of both sleeves white with chalk dust, a grey silk sash knotted once, grey silk squares at the knees. Hands and objects: the right hand rapping the desk, fingers chalk-white, a stick of chalk between thumb and forefinger; the left holding a round bronze mirror the size of a palm; on the desk a slate, another slate hanging on a cord at her waist. Power: a faint blue Water shimmer in the bronze mirror, a few cool motes. Background: rows of small wooden desks with children's heads bent over slates, blurred, a broad window onto the dark green of cypress trees. Light: soft window spirit-light from the upper left, chalk dust floating in the beam, a gentle rim light on her cheek. Expression: a warm, bright smile, eyes crinkled and fixed on one child, the brows lifted a little as if she has already chosen.

people.imagined: The Peak of Sitting Alone on a still night. He sits with a qin on his knees and his thumbnail plucks one string; a long yellow nail. He is not playing for anyone. His eyes look through the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated alone on a high peak at night, a qin on his knees, a single long yellow thumbnail poised on a string, eyes looking right through the viewer. Face (most important: eyes looking through you): a lean, ascetic face with a long straight nose, sunken cheeks, large pale unblinking eyes with a far-off gaze, thin white brows, thin lips closed, a wisp of white beard; about sixty. Hair: grey-white, long, tied up in a simple topknot with a jade pin, a few loose white hairs floating round his head. Body: lean, upright, cross-legged and utterly still. Clothing: a disciple of the abbey in cloud-grey silk robes of fine weave, a high collar with a faint rising-cloud border in silver, long wide sleeves spilling over the qin, a rope-silk belt, grey silk squares at the knees. Hands and objects: a long plain qin of dark wood laid across his knees with a single visible string; the right thumb with a very long yellow nail, clearly visible, poised at the string. Power: a faint pale silver Metal shimmer rings the string like a ripple of sound, motes of light drifting up. Background: a high bare rock peak, stars, a thin cloud. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left, silver on the strings, a thin silver rim along his nose and the edge of the qin. Expression: a far, unblinking gaze with no feeling in it, the face smooth and the mouth shut.

people.imagined: A guest cell at night. He is stuffing a sweet in his cheek with a forged certificate of calm in his hand, a merchant's son who has not been made calm, scribbling a letter to his cousin.
people.subject: The moment: sitting cross-legged on a mat in a guest cell at night, cheek stuffed with a sweet, scribbling a hasty letter to his cousin with a forged certificate of calm beside him. Face (most important: round cheeks sticky with sweets): a round, soft, pink face with very full cheeks shiny with sugar, a button nose, small bright eyes, a petulant little mouth with a crumb at the corner; about eighteen. Hair: black, oiled, in a tidy topknot with a jade bead, a few strands loose and clinging to his sweaty forehead. Body: plump, soft, a little tight in the clothes; legs crossed badly, one foot tucked under the knee, leaning on one elbow, belly pushed forward. Clothing: a guest in a robe of cloud-grey silk tailored far finer than the abbey's, three crossed collars with a rising-cloud border in silver, let out at the waist with a visible different-coloured gusset, sleeves lined in blue silk that shows when the cuffs fall back, a jade pendant carved like a small fish at the neck. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand over a half-written sheet marked only with short lines; the left holding a pastry; sweet wrappers scattered about. Power: a faint blue Water glint on the fish pendant, nothing more. Background: a bare cell with a narrow bunk, a shelf with three jars of sweets, a small window showing a patch of dark mountain. Light: warm lamp spirit-light from the upper left, his large shadow wavering across the wall, a soft rim light on his round cheek. Expression: eyes slid sideways, cheek bulging, the mouth pouting and a little pleased with itself.

people.imagined: Running through the market of Lam Yên Thị, a pocket of red leaves rustling, to sell bookmarks to keep the abbey in lamp oil. A bandaged toe shows under one sandal.
people.subject: The moment: running through the market of Lam Yên Thị with her skirt pocket full of bright red leaves rustling and a few held up in one hand, laughing, to sell bookmarks and keep the abbey in lamp oil. Face: a round, honest, freckled face with large clear brown eyes, a snub nose, thick brows, a wide laughing mouth; about twenty-two. Hair: dark brown in two braids tied with grey silk string, a red leaf in her hair. Body: strong, sturdy, light-footed; elbows out, head thrown back, one foot just leaving the ground. Clothing: a junior disciple of the abbey in graceful cloud-grey silk with a faint rising-cloud border, the skirt kilted up above the ankle with a cord, a side-pocket stuffed with red leaves, a thin sash with a red leaf stitched on each end, grey silk squares at the knees; sandals, a toe wrapped in white cloth that has come loose and trails behind her like a flag. Hands and objects: in the right hand a fan of bright red maple-shaped leaves held up like a hand of cards; the pocket spilling a few more. Power: none, only a faint blue Water glint in the air. Background: a crowded market with striped awnings and paper lanterns, a seller of hot dumplings, a donkey with baskets, tall maples in red and gold behind the roofs. Light: warm bright afternoon spirit-light from the upper left making the red leaves glow like stained glass, a golden rim light on her braids. Expression: a wide open laugh, eyes squeezed bright, cheeks flushed with running.

people.imagined: The bottom of a thin mica vein, lamp in hand, wary and certain he has found a new seam. His lamp gutters, as it always does, and he looks at the rope above with suspicion.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in a narrow mica tunnel with a lamp held up, looking suspiciously at a long rope hanging above him. Face (most important: mica glitter in his lashes): a gaunt, dusty face with deep-set dark eyes whose lashes glitter with silvery flakes of mica, heavy brows drawn together, a hooked nose, a mouth set in a suspicious line; about thirty. Hair: black, cut short with a knife in uneven tufts, glittering with dust. Body: wiry, hunched under the low roof, strong shoulders. Clothing: a junior disciple of the abbey in a plain flowing tunic of cloud-grey silk, kept clean, sleeves tied up with silk cord, a rope-silk belt, a pale cloth pulled down at the neck, dust at the hem, grey silk squares at the knees. Hands and objects: a small oil lamp in the left hand whose flame is guttering low; a short pick in the right; a thin pale seam of glinting mica in the rock beside him; a long rope hanging from above. Power: a faint silver-white Metal glitter drifts from the seam like frost motes. Background: a dark low tunnel with glints of mica in the walls, thin mist. Light: the guttering lamp from the lower left in amber spirit-light, a fleck of mica on his cheekbone catching it like a star. Expression: eyes narrowed and fixed on the rope above, the brows knotted and the mouth a thin, certain line.

people.imagined: The abbey kitchen at dawn. He lifts the lid off a huge millet pot and steam rises over his burned forearm, a ladder of pale scar marks, and he tastes it with a small frown; something is wrong with the salt.
people.subject: The moment: in the abbey kitchen at dawn, lifting the lid off a huge millet pot so the steam rises over his forearm, tasting from a spoon with a small frown; something is wrong with the salt. Face: a broad, gentle, round face with soft brown eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a wide mouth puzzled; flushed by steam; about fifty. Hair: grey-black, shaved short, covered by a clean white kitchen cloth knotted at the front. Body: stocky, wide, a solid stance; his wide back bent over the pot with elbows out, the neck thick. Clothing: a disciple of the abbey in a clean flowing robe of cloud-grey silk with softly crossed collars and a faint rising-cloud border, the wide sleeves tied back above the elbow with white cord, a white silk apron spotted with millet, a smaller cloth tucked into the belt, grey silk squares at the knees. Hands and objects: the cook's forearm burn-scarred in a clear ladder of pale marks, one above the other, plainly visible; in the right hand a wooden spoon; in the left a pot lid; a sack of salt beside him with a long ladle laid across it, a row of wooden bowls on the table. Power: a faint gold Metal glint in the salt and a pale green shimmer in the steam. Background: a stone kitchen with great black pots on a long brick hearth, hanging dried peppers, a stack of firewood, a small window showing grey dawn. Light: warm firelight from the lower left and a soft steam glow filling the upper half of the frame, a pale rim light on the white cloth. Expression: a small frown over a tasting mouth, the brows drawn and the eyes patient and puzzled.

people.imagined: The first long walk up the mountain. She has guessed where the Reader goes once a year, and her scabbed knees and short hacked braid show how fast she climbs, grinning, a small bell in her hand.
people.subject: The moment: halfway up a steep mountain path on her first long climb, she looks back over her shoulder, grinning, one hand holding a small bell, having guessed where the Reader goes once a year. Face: a thin, brown, wild, freckled face with big black eyes, strong brows, a wide cheeky mouth with a gap in the teeth, a scratch on the chin; about sixteen. Hair: black, the braid hacked off short with a kitchen knife, the ends uneven and tied with a bit of red thread, loose hairs stuck to her damp forehead. Body: small, tough, a quick climber; on one knee on the steep path with her free hand grasping a rock, back arched, face turned over her shoulder. Clothing: a junior disciple of the abbey in a short tunic of cloud-grey silk with a faint rising-cloud border, a rope-silk belt carrying a clay water-flask, short trousers above the knee, grey silk squares at the knees; plain sandals. Hands and objects: knees permanently scabbed in plain view; the right hand holding a small bronze bell on a cord; the left gripping a rock. Power: a faint ochre and silver shimmer of Earth and Metal about the bell, a few motes. Background: the path dropping steeply behind her through scree and thin pines, the grey bulk of the mountain half hidden in mist above. Light: cold bright morning spirit-light from the upper left on her scraped knees and the rim of the bell, a pale rim light on her cropped hair. Expression: a cheeky gap-toothed grin, wide bright eyes and flushed cheeks, a challenge flung over the shoulder.

people.imagined: The year she wrote down the novices' walk, on a sunlit path with the town among the clouds behind her. She is tall, nose sunburnt, braid grey as cloud, and she looks back down at someone she is teaching to climb.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, softly faded like old silk. A tall woman on a sunlit mountain path looks down at someone she is teaching to climb, one hand held out, the town among the clouds behind her. Face: a long, kind, resolute face with a sunburnt nose, wide-set brown eyes, strong brows, a generous smiling mouth; about fifty-five. Hair: a long braid the grey of cloud over one shoulder, a few grey strands blowing loose across her cheek, a silver pin at the crown. Body: tall, rangy, a walker's long stride; leaning forward from the waist, one hand stretched out and the other gripping the staff. Clothing: an elder of the abbey in flowing cloud-grey silk robes with three softly crossed collars and a rising-cloud border in silver, the sleeves rolled back, a rope-silk belt, grey silk squares at the knees, a silk satchel across the chest embroidered with tiny clouds, sandals bound with long straps. Hands and objects: the right hand held out palm-up in welcome; the left holding a roll of unmarked paper strips; a long walking staff. Power: a soft pale ochre shimmer of Earth qi gathers round her open hand, a few motes drifting. Background: the path below zigzagging through drifts of cloud, tiny roofs of a town among the mist, a pale silvery sky. Light: soft silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a thin rim light on her braid. Expression: an open, encouraging look, the brows lifted and the mouth smiling, patient eyes fixed below.

people.imagined: His last years as a guest, teaching a young woodcutter's son the abbey rule by a fire, a dry gourd in his lap, bent and gentle, remembering a spring that dried up.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, softly faded like old silk. A bent old man sits by a small fire in his last years, a dry gourd in his lap, speaking gently to a young woodcutter's son at the edge of the firelight, remembering a spring that dried up. Face: a very old, deeply lined face, thin and kind, with a hooked nose, sunken shining eyes, a long white wispy beard, bushy white brows, a toothless smile; about eighty-five. Hair: a few white wisps curling over the ears under a soft grey silk cap with a small jade pin. Body: bent nearly double, small and frail, shoulders drawn up and knees close inside his layers. Clothing: the last head of the abbey, dressed gently as a retired immortal: long robes of old cloud-grey silk, soft with wear, in three crossed collars with a faint rising-cloud border, neat squares of three different greys sewn at the knees and elbows, a rope-silk belt tied twice round the waist, a grey woollen shawl over the knees. Hands and objects: both hands holding a dry, pale, empty gourd on his lap, cracked with age; a walking stick beside him. Power: a very faint dry ochre Earth glimmer round the gourd, one or two pale motes in the firelight. Background: a rough stone hearth, a small iron pot, a low stool with a young man's shape at the edge of the firelight, a dark window with a pale star. Light: soft orange firelight from the lower left, moving on his face and leaving the corners dim, a thin gold rim light on the beard. Expression: a gentle, faraway look, the eyes wet and shining, the toothless smile slow and tender.

people.imagined: The oil store, dusk. She lifts a jar to her nose and sniffs it before signing, eyes narrowed, thinking of who will buy the spare jar this month and what she'll say to the Reader.
people.subject: The moment: in the oil store at dusk, she lifts a ceramic jar to her nose and sniffs it before signing, eyes narrowed, wondering who will buy the spare jar this month. Face (most important: oil-dark fingertips): a lean, sharp, tidy face with narrow clever eyes, thin arched brows, a long nose, a thin mouth; about forty-five. Hair: black with grey, in a tight bun with a wooden pin and a small silver comb. Body: narrow, brisk, upright; shoulders slightly raised, head tipped to one side in a careful assessing pose. Clothing: a disciple of the abbey in a clean high-collared robe of cloud-grey silk, two crossed collars fastened with small knots of cord, a faint rising-cloud border, sleeves tied up with silk cord, a rope-silk belt, a small brown silk apron with a ladle hung from it, grey silk squares at the knees. Hands and objects: fingertips stained dark brown with lamp oil, clearly visible against the jar; a small clay lamp with a tiny flame on the shelf; rows of stoppered jars behind, each with a small paper tag marked with a single dot. Power: a faint green Wood shimmer rises from the oil, a few warm motes. Background: a dim store with stone shelves of oil jars in three sizes, a pile of wicks, a funnel on a hook, a heavy wooden door ajar to the dusk. Light: amber lamp spirit-light from the upper left, the jars glowing and the corners dark, a thin rim light along her jaw. Expression: eyes narrowed over the jar, the lips pressed thin, a quick sums-in-the-head look.

people.imagined: On a cold autumn morning at the school gate, he leads one still child by the hand up the road. His ears are red with cold and his grey stubble untouched since the last feast day.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the school gate on a cold autumn morning, leading one still child by the hand up the road; his breath goes white before his mouth. Face: a long, hollow-cheeked face with a high forehead, pale watchful grey eyes, bushy grey brows, a thin mouth in a small smile that does not reach his eyes, grey stubble; the ears very red with cold; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, thin, cut short, a few stubble-like hairs at the temples. Body: tall, narrow-shouldered, a little bent; standing very straight with shoulders drawn back and his free arm hanging, the stiff posture of a man used to leading children. Clothing: a disciple of the abbey in cloud-grey silk robes with a faint rising-cloud border, a dark grey woollen scarf wound twice round the neck, a double row of stitching at the hem, a rope-silk belt, dark silk squares at the knees, a small bronze seal on a red cord at the belt. Hands and objects: the left hand holding out a child's small hand; the right holding a walking stick; the red ears in clear view. Power: a faint pale blue Water shimmer in his breath, a few frost motes. Background: a wooden school gate with a thin coat of frost, a path lined with dark cypresses, a row of small figures in grey waiting in the cold mist. Light: cold pearly spirit-light from the upper left turning his breath to white smoke, a pale rim light on his brow. Expression: a polite mouth smiling above cool eyes that never join in, the whole face held very still.

people.imagined: A stone courtyard, morning. She bends to apologise to the floor after stumbling, her lime-white knuckles on the flagstone, then straightens, afraid she is in the way.
people.subject: The moment: half bowing in a stone courtyard in the morning, apologising to the floor after stumbling, her lime-white knuckles pressed together. Face: a small, round, tired face with downcast brown eyes, thick soft brows, a small nose, a trembling mouth; about twenty. Hair: dark brown, in one braid tied with grey silk ribbon and tucked behind the shoulder, a stray lock stuck to her cheek that she pushes back with the back of a wrist. Body: small, stocky, rounded shoulders, hands pressed together, head lowered as if wishing to take up less space. Clothing: a junior disciple of the abbey in a cloud-grey silk robe a size too large, the sleeves hanging over her knuckles, a faint rising-cloud border, a rope-silk belt tied in a double knot, a grey silk square in a lighter grey at each knee; plain sandals. Hands and objects: knuckles white with lime dust, in clear view as she presses her hands together; a folded paper note at the edge of her sleeve. Power: a faint ochre Earth glimmer in the dust on her knuckles, nothing more. Background: flagstones swept clean, a low mossy wall, a lone cypress, a doorway with the shadow of someone passing, thin mist. Light: gentle pale morning spirit-light from the upper left showing the lime-white of her knuckles, a soft rim light on her braid. Expression: eyes lowered and glistening, brows drawn up in the middle, the mouth trembling on the edge of a sorry.

people.imagined: On the steep ridge path, reading a letter she should not read, her satchel smelling of salt and a red scarf blowing too long, a pinch of salt in her fist.
people.subject: The moment: walking up a steep ridge path, reading a letter she should not read, held at arm's length while her long red scarf flies, with a sly grin. Face: a thin, brown, quick face with bright black eyes, thin brows, a pointed little nose, a mischievous grin; about seventeen. Hair: black, in a short braid with a loose lock. Body: small, wiry, light-footed; climbing with a sideways skip, shoulders loose and elbows swinging. Clothing: a junior disciple of the abbey in a short-sleeved tunic of cloud-grey silk with a faint rising-cloud border, a cord belt, open-toed sandals, and a very long bright red silk scarf wrapped twice round the neck and flying behind her in the wind, unhemmed at the ends. Hands and objects: a folded letter held open in the right hand, the paper bare of marks; a small silk satchel of salt with a faded blue strap hanging at her side, a few white grains spilling; a pinch of salt in the left fist; a second folded letter poking from the satchel, a little grey ash on her thumb. Power: a faint gold Metal glint in the spilled salt, a few bright motes. Background: tall pines on both sides of the narrow path, a distant cliff with a thin waterfall, the grey roof of the abbey far above in mist. Light: bright morning spirit-light from the upper left lighting the red scarf like a flame, a pale rim light on her cheek. Expression: a quick sideways grin, bright eyes darting over the page, the look of someone enjoying a secret.

people.imagined: In the mica shed at dusk, counting the sheets one by one on a table with a slow, flat-footed walk and mica dust glittering in his eyebrows. He knows about the new seam and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: in the mica shed at dusk, standing at a table counting thin sheets of mica one at a time, slowly, with a calm face; he knows about the new seam and says nothing. Face: a broad, slow, soft face with heavy-lidded brown eyes, brows full of fine silver glitter, a short nose, a mild closed mouth; about twenty-three. Hair: black, cropped, glittering with dust. Body: heavy, flat-footed, broad-shouldered, a patient lumbering stance; arms heavy, round shoulders making a slow shape over the table. Clothing: a junior disciple of the abbey in a clean tunic of cloud-grey silk with sleeves rolled neatly twice, a faint rising-cloud border, a brown silk apron stitched in blocks of different threads with a long pocket for tally pebbles, dust at the cuffs, grey silk squares at the knees. Hands and objects: a stack of fine translucent mica sheets lit on the table, each pile held down by a flat pebble; the right hand lifting one pane to the light; a row of tally pebbles; a ledger of blank pages open beside them. Power: a faint silver Metal sparkle drifts off the mica like frost motes. Background: a mining shed with sacks of sorted mica stacked to the roof, a lantern hanging from a beam, a small door ajar on the dusk, mist. Light: amber lamp spirit-light from the upper left lighting the mica pane so it glows like a window, a silver rim light on his cropped hair. Expression: heavy lids and a slow, mild look, the mouth shut and the face giving away nothing.

people.imagined: Outside the dark hall at the yearly reading, waiting until dawn with the bell rope in her hand. She wishes she could go in, her shaved head cold, a pale half-moon on her palm from the rope.
people.subject: The moment: standing at night outside a dark stone door, holding the rope of a bell, waiting until dawn and looking longingly at the door during the yearly reading. Face: a pale, calm, delicate face with large dark eyes full of longing, fine level brows, a small mouth; about twenty-eight. Hair: none, a shaved head with a faint dark stubble, a thin grey silk veil over the head falling to the shoulder in a clean fold. Body: slim, straight, quiet; feet together, back straight, one hand on the rope and the other pressed flat against her robe, her whole posture a wait. Clothing: a disciple of the abbey in a high-collared robe of cloud-grey silk with a faint rising-cloud border, long narrow sleeves with a neat stitched cuff, a rope-silk belt, grey silk squares at the knees, plain straw sandals. Hands and objects: a pale half-moon callus on the left palm where the bell rope sits, clearly visible; the right hand holding the rope end; a small bronze bell on a bracket beside her; a small paper lantern at her feet giving a faint orange glow to the hem. Power: a faint blue-silver Water shimmer in the air about her, a few cool motes like dew. Background: a great stone door carved with a plain circle, a row of cypress shadows lining the yard, a few faint stars, mist. Light: cold blue starlight from the upper left, a thin line of warm gold light under the door lying across the threshold like a thread, a pale rim light on her veil. Expression: wide dark eyes fixed on the door, the brows lifted and uncertain, the lips just parted.

people.imagined: The school bench, midday. She cannot sit still: fingers drumming on everything, good boots muddy to the knee, she has just come back from the water's end on her own and is bored again.
people.subject: The moment: sitting sideways on a school bench at midday, drumming her fingers on the desk, glancing at the window, just back from the water's end on her own and bored again. Face: a pretty, sharp face with large bright dark eyes, thin impatient brows, a small straight nose, a mouth set in a pout; about eighteen. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a sea-blue silk ribbon, a loose strand slipped from it and clinging to her neck. Body: slim, restless; one knee up on the bench, chin on her shoulder. Clothing: a merchant's daughter among the disciples, in a robe of fine sea-blue silk, neat and costly, with a cross collar, three layered collars of paler blue gauze, a stitched wave pattern in silver thread at the hem, a silk sash with a coin-purse and a jade pendant, and embroidered slippers spattered with mud to the knee. Hands and objects: the fingers of both hands drumming on the desk; a small hanging lamp charm at the belt; a slate with only scribbles. Power: a faint teal Water shimmer in the sea-blue silk, a few cool motes. Background: a classroom with rows of benches and children in grey bent over slates, the teacher's desk, a window onto dark cypresses under a pale sky. Light: cool pearly spirit-light from the upper left making the silk shine like water, a soft rim light on her ponytail. Expression: lips pushed into a pout, eyes sliding to the window, the brows drawn in impatience.
